## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Distracted driving, emotions and electronic devices

FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A01
A first handheld device violation costs one hundred to two hundred dollars, while a repeat violation costs two hundred fifty to five hundred dollars [A01].
Why it matters: group device fines; difficulty high; prereq sec12-F14; confusables sec12-F14, sec12-F15
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A01
Points for handheld device use attach only to convictions inside a designated work zone with workers present, two for a first and five for a repeat, while the fines apply everywhere [A01].
Why it matters: group device penalties; difficulty high; prereq sec12-F14; confusables sec12-F15, sec12-F14
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A01
The device ban applies even while the vehicle is stopped on a public highway, so waiting at a red light is not an exception [A01].
Why it matters: group device law scope; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F13; confusables sec12-F13, sec12-F12
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A01
Strong emotion is handled by cooling off before driving, while running late is handled by leaving early, two different cures for two different risks [A01].
Why it matters: group emotions and time; difficulty low; prereq sec12-F10; confusables sec12-F10, sec12-F11
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0056]
